plugins.name: cc-hero
plugins.description: Guitar practice in a Claude Code pane: songs and chord sheets scroll past a now-marker as tablature and notation, scored from the microphone or a USB guitar interface; Ultimate Guitar search, fingerpicking, scales, CAGED, strumming patterns, a tuner, run history and a coach. Needs function hooks (early access): CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1.
